svg.text: Steps on the left (screen · action). Edge cases on the right.
Home: TodayCard shows Session A · Lower
Log opens on Exercise 1, Sets prefilled
from last time; Suggested target shown
Tap Confirm Set (C-06) or edit a field
Set 2 beats Best: PR! marker on the row
Optional RPE tap (C-05). Bar changes to
Exercise menu › Swap › pick a similar
rest are recorded as skipped' › Finish
Finish summary: duration, Sets, PRs with
previous best; unlock toast if a Badge
Invalid input: field-level message under the
row; Confirm stays on that Set.
Leave mid-Workout: Back keeps it in
